For a NAS under $500 that can handle Plex 4K hardware transcoding, I'd prioritize an Intel-based model with Quick Sync Video, ideally an Intel N100, N150, or N305 processor.

My recommendation is to avoid ARM-based NAS devices and older Intel Celeron models unless you're primarily using Plex Direct Play.

One important distinction: 4K Direct Play is easy; 4K hardware transcoding is much more demanding, especially when converting HDR to SDR or burning in subtitles.

Also, Plex hardware transcoding generally requires Plex Pass.
